name: Sunview Group Berhad
overview: Sunview Group Berhad 今年完成以 RM70.0 million 收购一座 50 兆瓦大型太阳能光伏发电厂，并拟以 RM15.0 million 收购 JSNT 全部股权及承担其最多 RM40.0 million 债务，公司亦签订协议以约 RM30.1 million 出售 Winstar Capital Berhad 22.44% 股权，并已分阶段完成部分交割。
overview_en: Sunview Group Berhad completed the acquisition of a 50 MW large-scale solar PV power plant for RM70.0 million this year, and proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in JSNT for RM15.0 million plus settlement of up to RM40.0 million owing by JSNT, while proposing to diversify into solar power generation. The company also entered into agreements to dispose of its 22.44% equity interest in Winstar Capital Berhad for approximately RM30.1 million, with partial completions during the year.

segments.name: 太阳能发电与供应
segments.note: 公司完成收购50兆瓦大型太阳能光伏发电厂，并拟收购JSNT全部股权。
segments.note_en: The company completed the acquisition of a 50 MW large-scale solar PV power plant, proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in JSNT, and proposed to diversify into solar power generation.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: JSNT买卖协议的先决条件履行期限再延长175天至2027年3月31日，完成期限延至2027年5月31日。
actions.text_en: The fulfillment period for conditions precedent of the JSNT SSA was further extended by 175 days to 31 March 2027, and the completion date to 31 May 2027.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: SAM 2与PKNP及PKNP Reneuco签订债务更替协议，自2026年6月1日起承接太阳能电厂租赁协议下的权利与义务。
actions.text_en: SAM 2 entered into a novation agreement with PKNP and PKNP Reneuco to assume the rights and obligations under the Solar Plant Lease Agreement effective 1 June 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: JSNT买卖协议的先决条件履行期限延长90天至2026年10月7日，完成期限延至2026年11月30日。
actions.text_en: The fulfillment period for conditions precedent of the JSNT SSA was extended by 90 days to 7 October 2026, and the completion date to 30 November 2026.
